name: 薇拉·铜舌
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:218
who: Vera Brasstongue, a half-human half-dwarf forge-mistress of Furnace Street, ninety-six but looking about fifty because the dwarf half ages her slowly: about 158 cm, stocky and wide-shouldered, half a head shorter than a human woman and a head taller than a dwarf. Hair a dark brick red, singed so many times that she keeps it cropped to an inch. Mine-lamp golden-yellow eyes. Both forearms are thick and layered with old burn scars. A weathered, capable woman's face with fine lines at the eyes. She squats by a furnace as if she owned it. A brisk, dry, quietly proud air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a sturdy, weathered woman of about fifty, medium-large bright golden-yellow eyes, thin dark-red eyebrows, fine crow's-feet and smile lines, a short straight nose with a faint soot smudge, a firm mouth; hair a dark brick red cropped to an inch; skin warm fair with a flush from the furnace heat. She must read as a woman of about fifty: clear crow's-feet fanning from the outer corner of each eye, a line running from each side of the nose down past the mouth, a little slackness along the jaw, the lived-in face of a fifty-year-old craftswoman, nothing like a woman in her twenties or thirties. The burn scars are on her forearms only; her face is plain unscarred skin with just a faint soot smudge.
build: 158 cm, stocky and strong: broad shoulders, thick forearms, a D-cup, a solid waist and sturdy hips, built to swing a hammer all day.
palette: forge ash grey and burnt brick red, mine-lamp gold, smoked leather brown, dull copper
casual: Her working dress: a heavy dwarvish leather apron pocked with tiny spark-burn holes all down the front over a coarse undyed wool shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, dark trousers and heavy iron-toed boots; smoked mica goggles hanging round her neck on a cord; a wrench longer than her forearm tucked through the belt; at the belt also a fist-sized magic furnace core split in two and bound together with copper wire, dark, no fire in it. She stands with one hand on the belt, a dry, confident look.
private: Resting after the last furnace is banked: the apron off, a loose long-sleeved wool shirt rolled to the elbow, a dark wool waistcoat, patched trousers and soft boots, the goggles off. The wire-bound dark furnace core still hangs at her belt. She sits on an upturned bucket with a steaming tin mug in both hands, the burn scars bare on her forearms, a tired, easy smile.
battle: Fighting beside her furnace: the spark-pocked leather apron over a studded leather jerkin, riveted vambraces, an iron pauldron on one shoulder engraved with a rune line that glows ember red, the goggles pushed up on her forehead, the wire-bound furnace core at her belt with a thin red light leaking through its cracks, a long wrench beside it. She grips a great two-handed forge hammer across her body, feet planted wide, a hard, grinning look.
formal: At an Institute day: her best working dress, the heavy dwarvish leather apron scrubbed and oiled, spark-holes left in place, over a clean dark wool shirt with sleeves folded to the elbow, a brass ring pin of the Institute on the strap, the smoked mica goggles on their cord, the wire-bound furnace core at her belt glowing a steady ember red through its cage. She stands square with scarred forearms bare and hands folded, a proud, steady look.
art: A close portrait, the face turned slightly, the mine-lamp gold eyes looking straight at the viewer with a dry half-grin, soot on one cheek. Orange furnace-mouth light from one side, hard shadows. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and the glowing edge of a furnace door. She wears the spark-pocked leather apron and the goggles at her neck.

name: 基诺
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:274
who: Kino, a beast-eared apprentice boy of Furnace Street, fifteen, small and thin, about 150 cm, wholly covered by his clothes. A pair of large grey-brown animal ears standing high on his head, each tipped with a tuft of white fur, swivelling toward any furnace sound; he has no separate human ears. A thin tail he winds round his waist while he works so the fire cannot singe it. Large round grape-purple eyes, usually rapt on a furnace. A smear of soot on one cheek from leaning in too close. A shy, earnest, curious air.
palette: soot grey and warm brown, grape purple, ash white, apron cream and rust
casual: His apprentice clothes: an old forge apron of Vera's cut shorter but still falling to his ankles, over a plain wool shirt with the sleeves rolled and dark trousers, the tail wound round his waist under the apron string; a wicker lunch basket on his forearm covered with a blue cloth; a thin iron poker he ground himself stuck in his belt, its tip still clean. He stands with the basket held in front, ears upright, a shy, bright look.
private: Resting at the back of the workshop: a loose long-sleeved wool shirt, dark trousers, soft shoes, the apron off, the tail hanging free. He sits on a stool with his chin on his knees watching a cold furnace, the poker beside him, a soft, dreamy look.
battle_pose: 3) the furnace-night outfit: braced and serious, the shoulders squared and the feet planted, both hands gripping the iron poker upright in front of him, the ears pricked, a firm closed-mouth expression; he does not fight.
battle: Keeping the furnace through a night of attack: the shortened apron tied tight over his shirt, leather gloves too big for him, the tail wound round his waist. Both hands grip the iron poker upright in front of him.
formal: On a street festival day: a clean cream shirt with a plain round neck under a short dark-blue wool vest with copper rivets, a small forge-apprentice's leather apron cut short and brushed clean, a little copper tag of Furnace Street on a cord, a blue kerchief at his neck, the tail tucked under the vest. He stands with his hands together in front, a nervous, earnest look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the large purple eyes wide and rapt as if watching a furnace, a clean serious expression with the mouth closed, both tufted ears upright. Warm furnace glow from one side, cool grey workshop light on the other. Foreground blur: drifting soot flecks and the blue cloth of the basket. He wears the long apron.

name: 斯约尔
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:330
who: Sjor, an old dwarf forge-master of Furnace Street, a hundred and sixty-two and looking about fifty-five: short and as broad as a furnace, about 136 cm, his head level with a human's chest. A grey-red beard braided into three plaits with the ends held by copper rings, singed short many times. No eyebrows; they burned away long ago and never grew back. Small pointed ears. Orange eyes like a furnace mouth. Both forearms are covered in fire-veined patterns, red-brown scorch lines that glow redder when he stands before a furnace. A stolid, unhurried air; the fire seems to bow before him.
face: FACE, as in the references: a broad, weathered dwarf face of about fifty-five, bright orange eyes, no eyebrows at all, deep lines at the eyes and mouth, a wide nose, a grey-red beard braided in three plaits, small pointed ears; skin warm ruddy from the heat. IMPORTANT: he has NO eyebrows at all. Above each eye the brow ridge is bare, smooth, slightly shiny old-burn skin with not one hair on it, in all four panels, the portrait and all nine expressions; anger, surprise and worry are shown with the eyes, the lids and the forehead creases, never with eyebrows.
palette: furnace orange and ember red, ash grey beard, dark leather brown, burnished copper
casual: His working dress: a heavy leather jacket of the Furnace-Vein dwarf line with the furnace-vein crest sewn on the shoulder, over a thick wool shirt, the sleeves pushed up to show the fire-veined forearms, dark trousers and iron-capped boots; a forging hammer with a polished head hung at the belt. One thumb is hooked in the belt, a gruff, steady look.
private: At the end of the day beside his workshop: the jacket off, a sleeveless leather vest over the wool shirt, his hands working a bellows with a salamander-hide skin and a black oak frame that draws without a sound, only air. A calm, absorbed look.
battle: Defending his forge: the Furnace-Vein jacket over a riveted leather cuirass whose plates are cut with rune lines glowing red at the seams, iron bracers, heavy gloves, the hammer gripped in one hand low at his side, the other fist closed. He stands planted before an open furnace mouth, the veins on his forearms glowing red, a hard, unmoving look.
formal: At a clan gathering of the Furnace-Vein line: a thick scrubbed leather forge apron with the furnace-vein crest riveted on the chest over a dark wool shirt, a wide belt with a plain buckle, a stone-grey shoulder mantle clasped with a copper ring, the three beard plaits oiled with the rings polished, and the veins on his forearms showing a faint ember glow. He stands with hands clasped before him, a grave look.
art: A low-angle broad bust, the head slightly lowered, orange eyes looking at the viewer, a stern, thoughtful expression, the beard plaits and the fire-veined forearms in the frame. Hard orange furnace light from below. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and a curl of smoke. He wears the leather jacket with the crest.
art_extra: His long hair and the three beard plaits stay grey with red streaks; the furnace glow may warm the lit edges only, and the hair must still read as grey, not brown or pink.

name: 博利·长辙
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:386
who: Boli Longrut, a halfling quartermaster of the Longrut family's supply train, forty; like all halflings he keeps a youthful round face and looks young: short and small, about 104 cm, level with a human's waist. Curly wheat-coloured hair with a few white hairs at the temples. Round cheeks and grass-green eyes, the Longrut family trait, that squeeze into slits when he laughs and go round when he haggles. His big bare feet have soles thick enough for gravel roads. Slightly pointed ears. A cheerful, shrewd, easy air.
palette: wheat gold and warm brown, grass green, worn white cuffs, brass
casual: His carter's dress: a deep-brown driving coat of the Longrut family with the cuffs worn white and two wheel ruts embroidered on the back, buttoned up over a plain shirt and trousers, bare feet; a bell hung on a cord round his neck as every Longrut driver wears; a fat leather pouch at his belt holding a small hand-scale, a roll of tally slips and sweets for the children. He stands with his thumbs in his belt, grinning.
private: Resting by the wagon at night: the coat off, a loose long-sleeved linen shirt, rolled-up trousers, bare feet toasting by the fire, the bell still on its cord. He holds a stick of boiled sweet in one hand and the little hand-scale in his lap, a sleepy, content smile.
battle: Guarding the supply train: the driving coat buckled, leather bracers over the sleeves, a padded jerkin underneath, bare feet planted wide on the road. He holds a long carter's whip coiled in one hand, the small scale and pouch at his belt, a wary, narrowed look.
formal: At the army's grain-counting: a clean dark-brown coat with fresh cuffs, a white collar, the embroidered wheel ruts bright on the back, the bell polished, his hair combed flat. He holds the little hand-scale up level in front of him, a polite, shrewd smile.
art: A bright close portrait, the head tilted, the grass-green eyes squeezed into a laughing grin, one hand holding up the little hand-scale as if weighing the viewer. Warm lantern light from the side, hard-edged shadow of the scale across his chest. Foreground blur: tumbling sweets and the blur of a wagon wheel. He wears the brown driving coat with the bell at his neck.

name: 薇布可·加尔本
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:539
who: Wibuke Garben, a nineteen-year-old human wheat-reaper of the Golden Ear plain, a grown young woman: about 165 cm, medium height with a trim waist and strong arms from cutting wheat. Long flax-coloured hair in one thick braid with a wheat ear from last year's harvest crown woven into it. Cornflower-blue eyes. Her cheeks are windburnt pink from the wheat fields and her palms are callused from the scythe handle. A steady, practical, warm air.
build: 165 cm, slender and strong: a straight back, a narrow waist, a C-cup, strong arms and shoulders from a lifetime of reaping, gently rounded hips.
palette: flax and wheat gold, cornflower blue, linen cream, sun-faded green
casual: Her reaper's dress: a coarse linen short jacket of the Golden Ear farmers with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a wide cloth band wrapped round her waist to protect her back, a plain long skirt of undyed wool to the shins over leggings, and sturdy boots. In her right hand a long-handled great scythe whose blade her grandfather's generation forged, polished brighter than new; on her back a worn straw hat her grandmother pressed on her, never once worn. She stands upright with the scythe grounded, a calm, steady look.
private: Resting on a farm porch at dusk: a soft long-sleeved linen blouse, a long brown wool skirt, thick knitted stockings and house shoes, the braid hanging over one shoulder with the wheat ear in it. She turns a cup of warm milk in both hands, a quiet, tired smile.
battle: Holding the last row: the linen jacket belted tight with the waist band, leather bracers, a short leather apron over the skirt for the legs, boots laced to the knee. She grips the great scythe two-handed at an angle across her body, the blade catching the light, a fierce, determined look.
formal: At a harvest feast: a cornflower-blue wool dress with long sleeves and a square neckline filled with a linen chemise, a wheat-ear brooch, the braid freshly done with a ribbon, clean boots. She stands with her hands folded in front, a shy, warm smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the cornflower-blue eyes looking straight at the viewer with an open, honest look, a small smile. Low golden evening light from one side across a wheat field. Foreground blur: bent wheat stalks and a few drifting awns. She wears the linen jacket with the wheat ear in her braid.

name: 梅宝·圆篮
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:595
who: Meibao Roundbasket, an old halfling priestess of the Wheat-Sharers' temple in the Golden Ear royal city, sixty-three; like all halflings she keeps a youthful round face, only a few soft laugh lines and silver hair showing her age: short and small, about 104 cm, hands and feet plump, quick on her feet. Hair silver-white in short curls, flour often on her eyebrows. Honey-coloured eyes that read a person's face first. A ring of golden lines on the palm of her left hand that glows faintly when she raises it to bless. Cheeks reddened from standing by ovens. A warm, brisk, motherly air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a round, kindly halfling face with youthful soft features, honey-coloured eyes with a few soft laugh lines at the corners, short silver-white curls, faint flour on the eyebrows, rosy cheeks, a small mouth with a warm smile.
palette: wheat-gold robe and flour white, honey amber, silver curls, baked-crust brown
casual: Her priestess's dress: a wheat-coloured long robe closed to the neck with a ring of wheat ears embroidered round the hem and the sleeves turned back so as not to get flour on them; a little clay jar hung on a cord at her waist, holding the temple's sourdough starter she has kept alive for decades; round her neck a small scythe whittled from wood as the priest's sign. She stands with her left hand raised palm out, the gold ring of lines faintly lit, a warm smile.
private: Resting in the temple kitchen after the last loaf is out: the robe changed for a soft long-sleeved wool dress with a flour-dusted apron, house shoes, the wooden scythe still at her neck and the clay jar on its cord. She sits on a low stool kneading a small ball of dough, a contented, sleepy smile.
battle_pose: 3) the field-hospital outfit: standing calm, the shoulders level, the left palm held open in front of her and glowing gold, the other hand steadying the clay jar at her waist; a gentle but firm expression; she does not fight.
battle: Tending the wounded through the night: the wheat robe tucked up with a cord, a plain apron over it, the sleeves rolled, the wooden scythe at her neck, the clay jar at her waist, her left palm open and glowing gold.
formal: At the autumn threshing rite: a long wheat-gold robe with a deep band of embroidered wheat ears, a crown of braided wheat stalks on her silver curls, the wooden scythe on its cord. She stands with both hands raised a little, palms open, the left glowing gold, a serene, kindly look.
art: A warm head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the honey eyes looking straight at the viewer with a gentle, steady look, the left hand raised near her cheek with its golden lines glowing. Warm oven-glow light from one side and cool grey window light from the other. Foreground blur: drifting flour and loaves of bread. She wears the wheat robe with the wooden scythe at her neck.

name: 哈鲁克
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:651
who: Haruk, a half-orc quarryman of the Golden Ear southern slope, forty-four and looking his age: very tall, wide and straight as a wall stone, about 209 cm, he must duck through doors. Ochre-grey skin and rust-red hair shaved to short stubble. Orange-yellow eyes that look at a person's footing before their face. The left tusk is broken off halfway (on the viewer's left when they face us), from a bone hammer on the day he first stood in the tile wall at eighteen. A leather brace is strapped round his right knee and he walks with a slight limp. A solid, quiet, dependable air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a broad, square, weathered half-orc face of about forty-five, orange-yellow eyes under heavy brows, rust-red stubble, a wide flat nose, two tusks rising from the lower jaw with the left one snapped off halfway (on the viewer's left when they face us); ochre-grey skin.
build: 209 cm, very tall and heavy-boned: wide shoulders, a thick waist, a straight back, a slight limp on the right leg.
palette: ochre grey and rust red, quarry stone white, worn leather brown, orange
casual: His quarryman's dress: a thick leather apron guarding chest and belly over a coarse undyed shirt with the sleeves cut short, heavy trousers, iron-toed boots, a leather brace round the right knee; a long-handled mountain axe with its edge honed pale white in his right hand; on his back an old round shield brought from the tile wall, a bright groove worn into each side of its rim; at the belt a cloth bag of chips of stone picked up on the slope, which he uses for counting when he is short of coin. He stands straight with the axe grounded, a steady look.
private: Resting at the quarry shed at dusk: the apron off, a sleeveless coarse shirt, loose trousers, the knee brace on, bare forearms, the shield leaning against the wall. He sits on a block of stone turning a small chip of stone over in his fingers, a quiet, thoughtful look.
battle: Holding a road: the apron over a scale-plated leather coat, heavy forearm guards, the knee brace, the round shield strapped on his left arm with its two worn grooves, the long-handled axe raised in the right hand at the shoulder. He plants his feet wide, a hard, level look.
formal: At a memorial for the wall: a clean thick leather quarryman's apron over a dark wool shirt with sleeves cut short, a broad belt with brass studs, a quarry-guild badge of a pick over a stone on a cord, boots scrubbed pale, the bag of stone chips at his belt where a few chips give off a faint pale glimmer, the tusk stump unadorned. He stands very upright with his hands at his sides, a grave look.
art: A portrait from slightly below, the face large, the orange-yellow eyes looking straight at the viewer with a calm, steady look, the broken left tusk sharp in the frame. Hard pale morning light from the left on stone dust in the air. Foreground blur: drifting stone dust and a broken stone. He wears the leather apron with the round shield on his back.

name: 吉纳维芙
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:798
who: Genevieve, a human griffon-rider captain of the White Kite wing on the southern wall, forty-one and looking about forty: tall and lightly built, about 172 cm, thin shoulders and back, sitting a griffon like a banner stuck in the saddle. White-gold hair cut short to the ears so the wind blows it all backwards. Bright yellow eyes like a kite-bird, narrowed when she looks far. An old pair of flying goggles pushed up on her forehead, polished pale lenses with a crack across the left one; faint goggle-marks round her eyes that never fade. A calm, crisp, commanding air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean, weathered woman's face of about forty, bright yellow eyes narrowed a little, thin light eyebrows, fine lines at the eyes from squinting at distance, a straight nose, a firm mouth; a faint pale ring of goggle-marks round the eyes; skin fair and wind-reddened.
build: 172 cm, slender and long-legged: thin shoulders and back, a B-cup, a narrow waist, strong legs from gripping a saddle; she walks with feet turned slightly outward.
palette: white gold and kite-wing white, bright yellow, light brown leather, dull steel
casual: Her rider's dress: light white-kite griffon-rider leather armour that protects only the chest and both flanks, a white kite, the bird of prey with spread wings folded, fixed on the left shoulder; a ring of clip-hooks round the waist to clip into the saddle; a long white streamer fixed on her back that trails four or five paces when she flies; leather gloves that were her father's, the left one stitched three times; the cracked goggles pushed up on her forehead. She stands with a gloved hand on her hip, a crisp, steady look.
private: Resting in the griffon loft: the armour off, a soft long-sleeved shirt of undyed wool rolled to the elbow, dark trousers and boots, the father's gloves tucked in her belt, the goggles pushed up on her forehead. She sits on a feed bin with a hand on a griffon's beak, a quiet, tired smile.
battle: Leading the wing in the air: the light white-kite leather armour buckled snug with faint rune lines glowing along its straps, the white streamer streaming behind, the goggles pulled down with the cracked left lens, the clip-hooks fastened. She holds a light ash-wood riding lance upright, its point at the top, a small wind-rune glinting on the head, a fierce, focused look.
formal: At a wing review: the light white-kite leather chest-and-rib armour brushed white and polished, the white kite with folded wings on the left shoulder, the long white streamer pinned down the back, a short white cape over one shoulder fastened with a griffon-feather clasp, polished boots, the father's gloves. She stands very upright with her hands behind her back and the goggles on her forehead, a calm, commanding look.
art: A dynamic portrait from slightly below, the face turned slightly, the yellow eyes narrowed and looking straight at the viewer with calm authority, the goggles on her forehead with the cracked left lens catching light. Cool bright sky light from above, warm gold edge light from one side. Foreground blur: rushing wind-torn cloud and loose white streamer. She wears the light leather armour with the white kite on her shoulder.

name: 伊玛·莱尔歇
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:854
who: Ima Leriche, a nineteen-year-old human flag signaller of the White Kite wing, a grown young woman but very small and slight: about 156 cm, thin as a flagpole. Tangerine-orange short hair tied in two short bunches that flick up like a lark's crest. Round mint-green eyes that never blink while she watches a flag. Cheeks red from the wind aloft, a flush that has never faded. Thin wrists with the bones showing as she snaps a flag. A quick, bright, hungry air; she eats three bowls at a meal.
build: 156 cm, petite and light-framed: thin arms with quick wrists, narrow shoulders, an A-cup, a slim waist and small hips.
palette: tangerine orange and mint green, flag red white teal and yellow, light brown leather
casual: Her signaller's dress: a short, very light leather jerkin lighter than a rider's over a long-sleeved shirt, trousers and soft boots; across her back a long leather flag-tube holding twelve flags, red, white, blue-green and yellow, their cloth woven with fine threads of ground magic crystal, the staffs poking out over her shoulder; clip-hooks at the belt polished by the saddle, a small cloth pouch round her neck holding her saved tips. She stands on tiptoe with both hands on the tube strap, a bright, eager look.
private: Resting in the loft: the jerkin off, a soft long-sleeved sweater and loose trousers, her bunches half undone, the pouch still at her neck. She sits cross-legged with a bowl of stew in both hands, a happy, hungry smile.
battle: Signalling in the air: the light leather jerkin laced tight, leather bracers, the clip-hooks fastened to the saddle, the flag-tube on her back. She stands in the stirrups snapping one red flag out at arm's length, the other hand gripping the saddle, a sharp, intent look.
formal: At a wing review: a clean short blue-grey wool jacket with brass buttons to the collar over a pleated knee-length skirt and dark stockings, the bunches freshly tied with white ribbons, the flag-tube on her back. She stands very straight with her hands at her sides, a proud, nervous smile.
art: A bright close portrait, the head tilted, the mint-green eyes wide and unblinking on a flag, a pleased smile. Cool bright sky light from above with warm gold edge light. Foreground blur: a streaming coloured flag and wisps of cloud. She wears the light leather jerkin with the two short bunches.

name: 雷金·蓝鳞
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:910
who: Regin Bluescale, a horned and winged dragonkin dragon-thunder gunner on the southern wall, sixty-nine and looking about forty-five because his kind ages slowly: tall and broad, about 192 cm, long-armed, the scales making him look wider than he is. Hard short indigo hair like scales. A pair of dark-blue horns curving back from the temples. Deep-blue scales over the sides of the neck and down both forearms, each overlapping the next, and a thin red line glowing between them when he fires. A pair of short folded wings on his back that cannot lift him and only shield from the wind. A blue-scaled tail coiled by the gun mount when he sits. Red slit-pupil eyes, half closed most of the time and wide when he watches the sky. A quiet, heavy, patient air. His hair is ONE colour only, a hard dark indigo all over, cropped short and close to the skull like a cap of scales; there is no white, grey or silver streak or forelock anywhere in it. Both horns curve backward from the temples, the same shape on both sides. The red eyes have clearly drawn vertical slit pupils in every panel.
face: FACE, as in the references: a broad, strong-jawed face of about forty-five, red slit-pupil eyes under heavy brows, hard short indigo hair, two dark-blue horns curving back from the temples, fine blue scales running from the neck up the sides of the jaw; skin fair under the scales.
build: 192 cm, tall and broad-shouldered: long arms, a heavy chest, a thick tail, the scales adding bulk.
palette: indigo and deep blue scale, ember red, scorched leather brown, dull iron
casual: His gunner's dress: a heavy leather apron scorched in patches over a sleeveless leather vest, both forearms bare so the blue scales show, dark trousers and iron-toed boots; an iron water flask on the belt; beside him a wooden bucket of water, as always at his gun mount; the short folded wings and tail uncovered. He stands with arms folded, a calm, heavy look.
private: Resting beside the gun mount at night: the apron off, a loose long-sleeved linen shirt open at the throat with the sleeves rolled, the tail coiled beside him, a wooden crate of dried meat open at his knee. He chews a strip of dried meat, a slow, content look.
battle: Firing the dragon-thunder gun: the scorched apron over a leather vest, heavy gloves, the red lines glowing between the scales of his forearms, the wings half spread. He stands braced at the breech of a rune-cut iron barrel whose engraved lines crackle with red-gold thunder, one hand on the firing lanyard, eyes wide and fixed on the sky, a hard, level look.
formal: At a gun-crew muster: a scorched but scrubbed heavy leather apron over a bare-armed dark vest so the blue scales show, a wide belt with a plain buckle, a brass crew badge of crossed barrels on a strap, leather bracers, boots scrubbed, the horns and short wings bare, and the red lines between his scales faintly lit. He stands very upright with his hands at his sides, a grave look.
art: A portrait from slightly below, the face large, the red slit eyes looking straight at the viewer with a heavy, patient gaze, a thin red line glowing between the scales of the jaw. Hard red-orange light from one side as from a gun muzzle, cool sky light from the other. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and smoke. He wears the scorched leather apron.

name: 库娅
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_四_炮的年月.md:1059
who: Kuya, a beast-eared courier girl of the Bellrun family, sixteen, slim and long-legged, about 156 cm, wholly covered by her clothes. Short reddish-gold hair kept above the ears as courier families require so it never falls in her eyes. A pair of long pointed animal ears with a black tuft at each tip, laid flat back when she runs; she has no separate human ears. A fluffy tail with a small copper bell tied to its tip. Amber eyes that narrow looking at a road and go round looking at a person. A quick, curious, spirited air.
palette: reddish-gold and warm brown, amber, copper bell, dark courier green and leather
casual: Her courier's dress: a short close-cut jacket buttoned to the collar with the cuffs and trouser legs tied tight, long sleeves and trousers, soft leather short boots her father made, a spare pair tied to the outside of her message satchel on her back; a short knife in an older sheath at her belt that was her mother's; the small copper bell on the tail tip that every Bellrun courier wears. She stands lightly on her toes, a bright, curious look.
private: Resting at a relay station: a loose long-sleeved wool tunic and long trousers, thick socks and house shoes, the satchel off and set beside her, the tail curled round her feet with its bell. She sits with a mug of warm milk in both hands, a sleepy, content smile.
